User story: As a traveler I want the Carnival experience protected so the principal goal is achieved
Acceptance criteria: Carnival date anchors route and Rio stay

User story: As Product Owner I want a feasible four-country sequence so time is spent on experiences not unnecessary transfers
Acceptance criteria: Four countries and overnight bases fit five-week journey

User story: As a traveler I want critical travel requirements and bookings resolved so disruptions are reduced
Acceptance criteria: Entry requirements and essential legs checked

User story: As a traveler I want meaningful time beyond Carnival so I experience the city
Acceptance criteria: Christ the Redeemer and Ipanema included with flexible time

User story: As a traveler I want Montevideo and Punta del Este with minimal hotel changes
Acceptance criteria: Montevideo base and Punta day trip by bus

User story: As a traveler I want Buenos Aires and Ushuaia sequenced effectively
Acceptance criteria: Split Buenos Aires stays around Ushuaia

User story: As a traveler I want Laguna Esmeralda and Beagle Channel experiences
Acceptance criteria: Hike and channel journey included subject to conditions

User story: As a traveler I want Iguazú and a Paraguay day trip before returning to Brazil
Acceptance criteria: Ciudad del Este as day trip and final São Paulo base

User story: As Product Owner I want alternatives for critical connections and weather
As a portfolio reader I want clear proof of route choices and product thinking
Acceptance criteria: Story backlog sprints and photo links accessible
